snippet.title: Demon Fish Dead Ahead 0.5 Beta Trailer -  Spooky Fishing JRPG for Game Boy and Game Boy Color!
snippet.description:
Sail around hell in this spooky fishing JRPG that's been simplified to exclude some elements in order to distill gameplay. Fight and capture a total of 16 fish (in the beta) and 2 bosses across 2 massive bodies of water. Contains 14 original musical numbers! 

Double the current content is planned for the final release! 

Play the beta now on Itch!
https://rikoclon.itch.io/demon-fish-dead-ahead
